body.content: Counterexample-first conjecture: What if the checklist is a PERFECT codification of expertise, but the panel's advantage is entirely on the agreement stratum? This would mean the checklist is valid AND the panel complies AND the panel outperforms, but the outperformance is not checklist-mediated — it is noise reduction. The divergence stratum is the only place the checklist's causal contribution can be isolated. If the divergence stratum is empty (checklist never disagrees with expert), the checklist is either trivial or the expert is already perfect, and no single-evaluation evidence can distinguish genuine gain from compliance.
body.possible_next_move: Examine whether the divergence stratum can be made non-empty by adversarial case selection without invalidating the checklist's validity.
body.why_keep_this: This is the counterexample that motivates the divergence-stratum criterion across all candidates: without divergence, there is no discriminating evidence.
